title: StudioAddSectionRequest
description: Body of POST /lessons/:lessonId/master/sections (2.18.0): asks for a new section of the master. It is stored as a review-comment of kind `add-section` (201 the new comment, 200 the same request already saved; the answer is a `review-comment`) and counts as an open change request. Sending it answers 409 cannot_start until the engine has the add-section mode. At least one of `notes` and `text` is required.

afterSection.description: A section id of the master the new section follows; omitted, null or `end` for the end.

sourcePages.description: For example 12-13. The Worker keeps the first 100 characters.

text.description: Typed text for the new section.
